spans.s:
m. (-ङ्गः)
Breaking down, destroying.
E.
प्र before भञ्ज to break, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Breaking, destroying.
m. (-नः)
Air or wind.
E.
प्र before भञ्ज to break, aff. युच्.

m. (-नः)
A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.)
E.
प्रभा light, beauty, अञ्ज to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-वः-वा-वं)
1 Born, produced.
2 Superior, powerful.
m. (-वः)
1 Generative cause, the basis or root of being or existence.
2 The operative cause, or immediate origin of being, as the father or mother, &c.
3 The place of receiving existence, or where an object is first perceived, as हिमवान् गङ्गा प्रभवः the Himavān mountain, (is) the place where Gaṅgā is first seen.
4 Birth, production.
5 The basis or origin of water, i. e. light.
6 The name of a

Muni.
7

Strength, superiority, power.
E.
प्र superiority or manifestation, and भव being.

m. (-वः)
1 Majesty, dignity, magnanimity, high spirit.
2 Power, strength.
3

Spirit.
4

Tranquillizing, conciliation.
E.
प्र pre-eminence, भाव quality.

n. (-वं)
Superiority, pre-eminence.
E.
प्रभु a master, aff. अण्.

n. (-नं)
1 Being born or produced.
2 Ruling, presiding.
E.
प्र before भू to be, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
1 Mighty, potent.
2 Born completely or well.
E.
प्र before भू to be, इष्णुच् aff.

f. (-ता)
Consequence, importance, power, authority, supremacy.
E.
प्र before भू to be, इष्णुच् aff., and तल् aug.

mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं)
1 To be born or produced.
2 Fit for rule.
E.
प्र before भू to be, aff. क्यप्; also प्रभवनीय and प्रभवितव्य.

f. (-भा)
1 Light, radiance.
2 The city of

KUVERA.
3

One of the wives of the sun.
4 A name of DURGĀ.
E.
प्र exceeding, भा to shine, aff. अङ् and टाप्.

m. (-रः)
1 The sun.
2

Fire.
3

The moon.
4 The ocean.
E.
प्रभा light, and कर what makes.

m. (-टः)
The firefly.
E.
प्रभा light, कीट insect.

mfn. (-भाक्)
Who or what shares or divides.
E.
प्र before भज to divide, and खि aff.

n. (-तं)
Morning, dawn, daybreak.
E.
प्र before भा to shine, aff. क्त.

n. (-नं)
Light, radiance, shining.
E.
प्र before भा to shine, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be irradiated or lighted.
E.
प्र before भा to shine, अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Proceeding from conscious majesty or power.
E.
प्रभाव, and ज born.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Luminous, radiant, splendid.
f. (-ती)
1 The mother of MALLI the 19th of the Jinas or Jaina saints.
2 The lute of one of the demigods attendant on ŚIVA, or other principal deities.
3 A form of poetical metre.
E.
प्रभा light or splendour, and मतुप् poss. aff.

m. (-सः)
1 A place of pilgrimage, in the west of India,
2 One of the eight

VASUS.
3

One of the Gaṇādhipas of the Jainas.
E.
प्र before भास to shine, aff. अच्.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Well cut or detached.
2 Severed, separated.
m. (-न्नः)
A furious elephant, one in rut or from whose temples the juice is exuding.
E.
प्र much, भिन्न broken, or seized with fury.

mfn. (-भु-भ्वी-भु)
1 Strong, able.
2 Always, eternal.
3 A superior, an owner, a proprietor, a master or mistress, &c.
m. (-भुः)
1 A master, a lord.
2 A name of VIṢṆ

Quicksilver.
4

Sound.
E.
प्र pre-eminent, भू to be, aff. क्विप्, and the final vowel made short.

f. (-ता)
Greatness, power, supremacy, lordship or sovereignty.
E.
प्रभु master, aff. तल्; also with त्व aff. प्रमुत्व n. (-त्वं.)

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Much, abundant.
2 Gone up or upwards.
3 Been, become, produced.
4 High, lofty.
5 Governed, presided over.
6 Mature, perfect.
E.
प्र principal, &c. भूत been.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Faithful, devoted.
m. (-क्तः)
A good horse.
E.
प्रभु a master, and भक्त worshipped.

f. (-ता)
Abundance, plenty.
E.
तल् added to the last; also प्रभूतत्वं.

mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु)
Strong, able.
E.
प्र before भू to be, aff. ष्णुच्.

f. (-तिः)
1 Manner, kind.
2 Etcetera, others, rest, remainder, (in composition); as गर्म्मुत्प्रभृतयःतृणं the grass called Garmut and other sorts; मुनयः सोमश्रवः प्रभृतयः the Munis, Somaśravas, and the rest; ततः प्रभृति thence, after that.
E.
प्र before भृ to nourish, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-दः)
Kind, sort, difference.
E.
प्र before भेद kind.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Falling down, being broken off or down.
E.
प्र before भ्रंश to break, pass. v., शानच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Fallen, dropping, fallen off.
2 Broken.
E.
प्र before भ्रंश to fall, क्त aff.

n. (-कं)
A chaplet of flowers suspended from the middle lock of hair.
E.
प्र before म्रंश to fall or depend, aff. क्त and कन added.

n. (-न्यं)
Power, authority.
E.
प्रभवन् being superior, ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-तं)
A present, an offering to a deity or sovereign, or a gift to a friend, a bribe, the Nezer of Hindustan.
E.
प्र and आङ् before भृ to nourish, aff. क्त; also with कन् aff. प्राभृतक, n. (-कं)
